purpose: Complete recovery of failed zram setup with its declared ExecStop after verified swap inactive
command:
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
assert len(Path('/proc/swaps').read_text().splitlines())==1,'swap still active; do not reset device'
commands=[['sudo','-n','/usr/lib/systemd/system-generators/zram-generator','--reset-device','zram0'],['sudo','-n','systemctl','start','dev-zram0.swap'],['sudo','-n','systemctl','start','rpi-zram-writeback.timer']]
for argv in commands:
 p=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 print(json.dumps(dict(argv=argv,returncode=p.returncode,out=p.stdout,err=p.stderr)),flush=True)
 if p.returncode:raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
p=subprocess.run(['systemctl','show','dev-zram0.swap','systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service','rpi-zram-writeback.timer','-p','Id','-p','ActiveState','-p','Result'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
print(json.dumps(dict(final_units=p.stdout,swaps=Path('/proc/swaps').read_text(),governor=Path('/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_governor').read_text())))
